ios.desc:
"World-class photography app"  - iMore
"The screen layouts are excellent. DSLRs could learn a thing or two."  - Engadget
"If you can name it, chances are ProShot has it" - Gizmodo

► Loved by over 1M+ photographers!

Welcome to ProShot, the ultimate manual camera app for iPhone and iPad.

ProShot puts the power of ProRAW, ProRes and DSLR controls right in your pocket, empowering you to capture stunning photos and videos in any situation. Whether you are a seasoned pro or just getting started, ProShot has something for you.

► MANUAL CONTROLS
Unlock DSLR-like precision for crystal-clear photos and video. Full manual, semi-auto, or smart Auto modes let you adjust exposure, ISO, white balance, and more, while auto ISO & shutter speed limits let you fine-tune motion blur and noise, just like the big cameras.

► PROFESSIONAL TOOLS
ProShot adjusts to your changing world. Fly through camera settings with its unique Dual Dial system. Record video instantly with the press of a button. Paint with light trails or stargaze via Bulb mode. Fine-tune your experience with remappable controls, histograms, focus peaking, compass, Night UI to preserve vision, and so much more.

► PRIVACY BUILT-IN
Zero data harvesting - your images and info stay secure, because that’s the way it should be.

There is so much more to ProShot. Below is a list of some of the many features waiting for you. ProShot is under constant development, so great new things are always on the horizon!

► PHOTO FEATURES
- Auto, Program, Manual, and two Custom modes, just like a DSLR
- Shutter priority, ISO priority, Automatic, and Full Manual control
- Adjust exposure, ISO, shutter speed, flash, focus, torch intensity, white balance and more
- Set max ISO and max shutter speed options
- ProRAW, RAW (DNG), HEIC, and JPEG formats
- Option for zero processing for pure images without AI filters
- Live Photo support
- Unlimited shutter speed (Bulb) with Live Photo support for gorgeous night videos
- Portrait mode
- Black and White mode
- 16:9, 3:2, 4:3, and 1:1 aspect ratios
- Light Painting with special modes for capturing water and light trails
- Timelapse (intervalometer and video), with full manual control
- Zero-lag bracket exposure up to ±3 EV
- Manual focus assist and focus peaking with customizable color
- Front-facing camera support with full manual control
- Zoom up to 15X using just one finger
- Grid, histogram, compass, noise reduction and many more options
- Customizable accent color and UI layout to
